description: This line plot, titled "Hidden State Mean," illustrates the absolute mean values of hidden states across different layers in a neural network model, comparing three distinct conditions: the hidden state mean before the gate, the hidden state mean after the gate, and the hidden state mean of a baseline. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is linear and spans from 0 to 22, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," is also linear and ranges from 0 to 4, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The blue dashed line, representing the hidden state mean before the gate (with an average value of 0.71), starts near 0.0, fluctuates slightly with minor peaks around layers 3 and 12, and then rises sharply after layer 20, reaching approximately 4.3 at layer 22. The orange dotted line, representing the hidden state mean after the gate (with an average value of 0.05), remains very close to 0.0 throughout the entire range, showing minimal variation. The green solid line, representing the hidden state mean of the baseline (with an average value of 0.04), also remains near 0.0, with a slight upward trend, reaching approximately 0.15 at layer 22.
